scientific_integrity: Complete support classification, counting, and adaptive-rank arguments are proved for every positive bipartition size; finite enumerations separately check representative cases. No independent certification has been claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to binary vertex-colour equality tests on proper colourings of complete bipartite graphs and does not assert analogous results for arbitrary bipartite graphs, alternate query semantics, or the full shattered-support polynomial when q>=4. Priority search is limited to available evidence.
title: Exact shattering polynomial and palette transition for complete-bipartite proper colourings
